fullContentHtml:
NTA UGC NET June Re-Exam Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the Re-Exam Admit Card for the University Grant Commission UGC National Eligibility Test NET Assistant Professor / JRF June 2026 examination. The online application process for NTA UGC NET June Online Form 2026 were accepted from 29 April 2026 to 24 May 2026. The re-Examination is going to conducted from 09-10 September 2026 Candidates can download their NTA UGC NET June Re-Exam City Details 2026, which are given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 April 2026
  • Last Date : 24 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 24 May 2026
  • Correction Date : 26-28 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 22-30 June 2026
  • Re-Exam Date : 09-10 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 10 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 17 June 2026
  • Answer Key : 16 August 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 28 August 2026
  • Result : 28 August 2026
  • Re-Exam City Details : 01 September 2026
  • Re-Exam Admit Card : 04 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General : Rs. 1150/-
  • EWS, OBC : Rs. 600/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 325/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.
